Exploitability_explanation: API call confirmed. The DynamicListener in pkg/cluster/https.go is configured to dynamically add SANs based on the Host header of incoming requests. This implementation lacks explicit limits on the number of SANs or the size of the certificate, satisfying the core constraint for a TLS SAN stuffing attack (DoS).

API confirmed. The default KubeletConfiguration in pkg/daemons/agent/agent.go omits the ReadOnlyPort field when it's set to 0 during serialization. This leads to the kubelet falling back to its internal default of port 10255, providing unauthenticated access to the read-only API as described in the CVE.
